scripts.migrate:local: pnpm run db:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: pnpm run db:generate && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: pnpm run migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:tail: rm -f wrangler.log && pnpm run deploy && wrangler tail --format pretty | tee wrangler.log
